visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A middle-aged woman with short brown hair, wearing a beige t-shirt under a blue denim-style apron, stands behind a busy food stall in a bustling indoor market. She smiles broadly while gesturing toward various traditional snacks, including steaming cakes and rice bowls stacked high on the counter. (2) The scene shifts to extreme close-up shots of traditional food items. Stacks of Zongzi wrapped in bamboo leaves are shown, followed by a detailed view of a green glutinous rice cake being torn apart by hand to reveal a savory, dark meat and vegetable filling inside a textured dough. (3) A clear plastic container filled with oily rice, topped with mushrooms and sliced pork, is held up for the camera. Another shot shows a Zongzi after it has been unwrapped, revealing the moist reddish-brown rice, peanuts, and meat filling. The lighting is bright and even throughout. (4) Large, square slabs of Turnip Cake are displayed in rows on a tray, topped with crispy fried shallots. A man wearing a striped polo shirt picks up a sample with a toothpick, while another block of the cake is shown in its clear plastic packaging for sale. (5) The stall owner is seen again, efficiently packaging food into plastic bags. Multiple small white bowls containing different snacks are spread across the counter. Customers with face masks are visible in the background, interacting with the staff and browsing the extensive variety of traditional items. (6) The final shot shows a wide view of the stall's colorful signage, with the owner handing a filled plastic bag to a customer. The transaction is completed as money is exchanged, capturing the lively atmosphere of the market stall as other shoppers move through the frame.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) A friendly male narrator begins the introduction with a moderate speech rate and clear articulation. He is accompanied by an upbeat acoustic BGM featuring guitar and piano at approximately 110 BPM. In the background, a low-intensity crowd murmur from the market environment is clearly audible as a background layer. (2) The female stall owner's voice briefly interrupts with a high-pitched, joyful laugh while mentioning the stall's long history of over fifty years. This shift in vocal texture occurs alongside a subtle but distinct rustling sound of plastic bags being handled by the staff in the background. (3) The male narrator resumes his descriptive narration about the various traditional snacks available at the stall. A distinct "thud" sound of a plastic container being placed on the counter is heard, followed by a slight shift in his vocal intensity as he emphasizes the quality of ingredients. (4) As the narration transitions to a list of specific foods like zongzi and turnip cakes, another series of rhythmic plastic crinkling sound effects are heard from the handling of food. The BGM remains consistent in tempo and volume, maintaining a positive and energetic acoustic atmosphere. (5) The narrator provides a concluding call to action in a polite and inviting tone, encouraging viewers to visit. The BGM swells slightly in amplitude as the voices cease, and the market's ambient room tone remains briefly audible before the audio track ends with a final hard cut.

narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video serves as a promotional vlog for 'Shuang Hao Oily Rice,' a long-standing food stall in Wumiao Market, Kaohsiung. It aims to showcase the variety and quality of traditional Taiwanese snacks while highlighting the stall's 50-year heritage to attract local customers and tourists.
